    President Donald Trump has fired Attorney General Pam Bondi, with her former deputy,
    Todd Blanche, taking over as acting attorney general. Blanche, who previously served as Trump's defense attorney and as Deputy Attorney General, was appointed following Trump's dissatisfaction with Bondi’s handling of Jeffrey Epstein files. 
    • Acting Attorney General: Todd Blanche is serving in an acting capacity.
    • Reason for Change: Trump expressed frustration over the lack of prosecution against political opponents and the management of files, reports CNN.
    • Future Role: Bondi is transitioning to a role in the private sector.
    • Potential Permanent Replacement: Reports indicate that EPA administrator Lee Zeldin is under consideration to permanently replace Bondi. 
    Blanche has been a vocal supporter of the administration's actions regarding the Department of Justice.

    Donald Trump holds one earned bachelor's degree: a Bachelor of Science in Economics from the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School of Finance and Commerce, conferred in 1968
    . He was awarded five honorary doctorates, but most were revoked by 2021, leaving him with two from Liberty University. 
    • Earned Degree: Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Economics (University of Pennsylvania, 1968).
    • Honorary Degrees Remaining: Two from Liberty University (Doctor of Business, awarded 2012; Doctor of Laws, awarded 2017).
    • Revoked Honorary Degrees: Lehigh University (Doctor of Laws, 1988), Wagner College (Doctor of Humane Letters, 2004), and Robert Gordon University (Doctor of Business Administration, 2010) were revoked in 2015 and 2021
      .
